applicabilityBasis.summary: LUSD is a transferable dollar-targeted crypto-collateralized stablecoin created by borrowing against ETH. Holders may swap it for one dollar worth of ETH less fees, but Liquity disclaims any claim against a natural or legal person and no issuer obligation to redeem for currency or bank-deposit monetary value is identified. Its general stablecoin use makes payment applicability genuinely ambiguous rather than categorically excluded.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. Liquity AG develops software and disclaims operation or control of the immutable V1 protocol; it is not recorded as LUSD issuerEntity. The public redemption policy concerns dollar-valued ETH less fees, not payment of one U.S. dollar by a legal issuer. No public GENIUS approval, state qualification, official application or foreign registration was identified in the checked sources. Prudential rules remain proposed; the effective September 30 Treasury SCRC rule is procedural and does not establish token authorization or general implementation effectiveness. DASP restrictions have distinct statutory timelines.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the opened regulator materials, directories, protocol disclosures and token/name-specific official-domain searches did not identify a public GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, official GENIUS application or registered foreign-issuer exception for LUSD. No token-specific GENIUS enforcement action was located in the searched domains. This is a bounded public-evidence finding, not proof that no unpublished application exists; generic bank-charter or virtual-currency licensing would not establish these statuses.
